+"""In-memory stand-in for the OpenSearch client, faithful to its near-real-time semantics.
+
+Documents become searchable only after a refresh, as with the real cluster's
+refresh interval.
+"""
+from collections import defaultdict
+
+
+class InMemoryIndex:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._pending = defaultdict(list)
+        self._visible = defaultdict(list)
+
+    def index(self, index: str, document: dict) -> None:
+        self._pending[index].append(dict(document))
+
+    def refresh(self, index: str | None = None) -> None:
+        names = [index] if index else list(self._pending)
+        for name in names:
+            self._visible[name].extend(self._pending.pop(name, []))
+
+    def search(self, index: str, text: str, filters: dict | None = None, size: int = 10) -> list[dict]:
+        hits = []
+        for doc in self._visible.get(index, []):
+            if text.lower() not in doc.get("body", "").lower():
+                continue
+            if filters and any(doc.get(k) != v for k, v in filters.items()):
+                continue
+            hits.append(doc)
+        return hits[:size]
+
+    def delete_index(self, index: str) -> None:
+        self._pending.pop(index, None)
+        self._visible.pop(index, None)

+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
+
+CENT = Decimal("0.01")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LateFeePolicy:
+    grace_days: int
+    monthly_rate: Decimal
+    cap: Decimal
+
+
+DEFAULT_POLICY = LateFeePolicy(grace_days=10, monthly_rate=Decimal("0.015"), cap=Decimal("50.00"))
+
+
+def late_fee(balance: Decimal, days_overdue: int, policy: LateFeePolicy = DEFAULT_POLICY) -> Decimal:
+    """Interest on the open balance for each started month past the grace period, capped."""
+    if balance <= 0 or days_overdue <= policy.grace_days:
+        return Decimal("0.00")
+    months = (days_overdue - policy.grace_days) // 30 + 1
+    fee = balance * policy.monthly_rate * months
+    return min(fee, policy.cap).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
